import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def get_color (t : Node) : Color :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ _ _ => c
  | Node.Empty => Color.Black -- Empty nodes are black

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def get_left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => some l | _ => none

def get_right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => some r | _ => none

def is_not_empty (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with | Node.Empty => False | _ => True

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_right_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  match t with
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ =>
    -- Strictly match Dafny/Verus: Only require Left child to be Red.
    -- The Double-Red context is checked by the caller (insert), not this helper.
    is_red l
  | _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def rotate_right (t : Node) 
    (h_precond : rotate_right_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree _ lv ll lr) r =>
      Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)
  | Node.Tree c v Node.Empty r => Node.Tree c v Node.Empty r
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_right_postcond (t : Node) (result : Node)
    (_ : rotate_right_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  view result = view t ∧
  is_bst t → is_bst result ∧
  match result, t with
  | Node.Tree c' _ _ r', Node.Tree c _ _ _ =>
      -- New root color matches old root color
      c' = c ∧
      -- New right child is Red
      (match r' with
       | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => True
       | _ => False) ∧
      -- Black height preservation
      (black_height t ≠ -1 → black_height result = black_height t)
  | _, _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem view_tree (c : Color) (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    view (Node.Tree c v l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {v} := by
  rfl

theorem is_bst_tree (c : Color) (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    is_bst (Node.Tree c v l r) ↔
      ((∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧ is_bst l ∧ (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧ is_bst r) := by
  rfl

theorem bh_red (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l r) =
      (if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r
        then black_height l else -1) := by
  simp only [black_height]
  rw [if_neg (show ¬((Color.Red == Color.Black) = true) by decide)]

theorem bh_black (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black v l r) =
      (if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r
        then black_height l + 1 else -1) := by
  simp only [black_height]
  rw [if_pos (show ((Color.Black == Color.Black) = true) by decide)]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem rotate_right_postcond_satisfied (t : Node)
    (h_precond : rotate_right_precond t) :
    rotate_right_postcond t (rotate_right t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact absurd h_precond (by simp)
  | Tree c v l r =>
    cases l with
    | Empty => exact absurd h_precond (by simp [is_red])
    | Tree lc lv ll lr =>
      cases lc with
      | Black => exact absurd h_precond (by simp [is_red])
      | Red =>
        intro h
        obtain ⟨-, hbst⟩ := h
        rw [is_bst_tree] at hbst
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hbst
        rw [is_bst_tree] at h2
        obtain ⟨h2a, h2b, h2c, h2d⟩ := h2
        rw [view_tree] at h1
        have hlv : lv < v :=
          h1 lv (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr rfl))
        have hbh : black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) ≠ -1 →
            black_height (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)) =
              black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) := by
          intro hne
          cases c
          · simp only [bh_red] at hne ⊢
            split_ifs at hne ⊢ <;> omega
          · simp only [bh_red, bh_black] at hne ⊢
            split_ifs at hne ⊢ <;> omega
        have hres : is_bst (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)) := by
          rw [is_bst_tree]
          refine ⟨h2a, h2b, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [view_tree]
            intro x hx
            simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
            rcases hx with (hx | hx) | hx
            · exact h2c x hx
            · exact lt_trans hlv (h3 x hx)
            · rw [hx]; exact hlv
          · rw [is_bst_tree]
            exact ⟨fun x hx => h1 x (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_right _ hx)),
              h2d, h3, h4⟩
        exact ⟨hres, rfl, trivial, hbh⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof

    (h_precond : rotate_right_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree _ lv ll lr) r =>
      Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)
  | Node.Tree c v Node.Empty r => Node.Tree c v Node.Empty r
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_right_postcond (t : Node) (result : Node)
    (_ : rotate_right_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  view result = view t ∧
  is_bst t → is_bst result ∧
  match result, t with
  | Node.Tree c' _ _ r', Node.Tree c _ _ _ =>
      -- New root color matches old root color
      c' = c ∧
      -- New right child is Red
      (match r' with
       | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => True
       | _ => False) ∧
      -- Black height preservation
      (black_height t ≠ -1 → black_height result = black_height t)
  | _, _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem view_tree (c : Color) (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    view (Node.Tree c v l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {v} := by
  rfl

theorem is_bst_tree (c : Color) (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    is_bst (Node.Tree c v l r) ↔
      ((∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧ is_bst l ∧ (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧ is_bst r) := by
  rfl

theorem bh_red (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l r) =
      (if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r
        then black_height l else -1) := by
  simp only [black_height]
  rw [if_neg (show ¬((Color.Red == Color.Black) = true) by decide)]

theorem bh_black (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black v l r) =
      (if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r
        then black_height l + 1 else -1) := by
  simp only [black_height]
  rw [if_pos (show ((Color.Black == Color.Black) = true) by decide)]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem rotate_right_postcond_satisfied (t : Node)
    (h_precond : rotate_right_precond t) :
    rotate_right_postcond t (rotate_right t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact absurd h_precond (by simp)
  | Tree c v l r =>
    cases l with
    | Empty => exact absurd h_precond (by simp [is_red])
    | Tree lc lv ll lr =>
      cases lc with
      | Black => exact absurd h_precond (by simp [is_red])
      | Red =>
        intro h
        obtain ⟨-, hbst⟩ := h
        rw [is_bst_tree] at hbst
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hbst
        rw [is_bst_tree] at h2
        obtain ⟨h2a, h2b, h2c, h2d⟩ := h2
        rw [view_tree] at h1
        have hlv : lv < v :=
          h1 lv (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr rfl))
        have hbh : black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) ≠ -1 →
            black_height (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)) =
              black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) := by
          intro hne
          cases c
          · simp only [bh_red] at hne ⊢
            split_ifs at hne ⊢ <;> omega
          · simp only [bh_red, bh_black] at hne ⊢
            split_ifs at hne ⊢ <;> omega
        have hres : is_bst (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)) := by
          rw [is_bst_tree]
          refine ⟨h2a, h2b, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [view_tree]
            intro x hx
            simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
            rcases hx with (hx | hx) | hx
            · exact h2c x hx
            · exact lt_trans hlv (h3 x hx)
            · rw [hx]; exact hlv
          · rw [is_bst_tree]
            exact ⟨fun x hx => h1 x (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_right _ hx)),

  -- !benchmark @end proof

What the required natural-language task asks for:
- a right rotation for an LLRBT,
- under the precondition that the node has a left red child and that left child also has a left red child (“double red on left”),
- with the rotated colors arranged so the new root gets the old root’s color and the old root becomes red on the right.

What the student implemented:

Even if the rotation function is still structurally the right-rotation algorithm, the problem statement explicitly requires the fixup in the double-red-left setting.
